objective: Dispatchers trust the morning schedule enough to send it as it is
narrative: Dispatchers spend the first hour of the day rebuilding our schedule because it ignores skills and parts. Until they trust it, nothing else we build for them matters. This term we add skills and parts constraints and measure whether they stop editing. We are not building live re-planning yet.

objective: Technicians finish more jobs on the first visit
narrative: Almost four in ten jobs need a second visit, mostly because the technician arrived without information or parts. Checklists exist but don't load without signal, which is where most jobs happen. This term is about getting the checklist in front of the technician before arrival. We are not doing parts prediction yet.

objective: Every customer is billed from one platform without losing goodwill
narrative: Two billing systems block per-job pricing. A migration costs customers effort and trust, so it has to come with something they value: fewer billing errors. The date matters because the pricing pilot is planned for next term.
